name: The Governing Council of the Hetman Government and the Lubny Treaty (1734–1750) (C0029)

techniques.comment: The return of the Zaporozhian Sich under the empire's authority on the crown's terms: "For tactical reasons, in the course of preparations for the next Turkish war, Anna amnestied the Zaporozhians and allowed them to return to the old Sich grounds (1734) and found the New Sich"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 1 2003) – the amnesty formalized the Cossacks' passage under Russian authority with an obligation of military service.

Blocking the election of a new leader and creating a hybrid administration for direct control: "The Governance included the tsar's resident in Ukraine, Prince O. Shakhovskoy, with 2 Russian officials… as well as general quartermaster Ya. Lyzohub with 2 Ukrainian officers"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 8 2011) – a formally equal collegium actually headed by the tsar's resident.
